layout.note: All 36 sources are placed once, in order: 269 output rows, 260 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 27 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. At r00001/fa a section label opens the passage inside the same row; that is the base corpus's dominant style (241 fused rows against 43 label-only rows), so it is accepted, and the earlier suggestion to detach bare ordinals is withdrawn. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
